title: Tithe
subtitle: the men they send
narrative: Every institution has a face it shows when it comes to collect. Sometimes it's a noble standing over the servant scrubbing his floor. Sometimes it's two knights at the door with polearms. Sometimes it's a vampire pontiff in a gold mask, or a stern blonde mage with cracked light in her hands, or two lawmages in white-and-blue robes putting a captive in chains. Sometimes it's just the helmets in formation walking past the temple. The bundle holds ten cards. Most TCG art lets these figures pass as background dignity. This one does not.

cards.name: Wicked Guardian
cards.why_it_fits: Two figures, one standing, one on hands and knees. The noble looks bored. The servant scrubs. Flavor text reads: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors." Mark Rosewater's Eldraine preview essay named this card specifically as part of the set's Cinderella arc; the inequality is the design.

cards.name: Charity Extractor
cards.why_it_fits: Two knights in full plate, polearms angled forward, faces hidden under helmets. Artist Matt Stewart's preview interview describes the brief as a generic Orzhov knight; he added the keys at one knight's hip and the lockbox at the other's. Charity here is not the word's usual meaning.

cards.name: Pitiless Pontiff
cards.why_it_fits: Vampire cleric in a gold filigree mask, holding a curved dagger. Orzhov vestments. Flavor text: "Pay in gold. Pay in blood. Pay with the servitude of your spirit kin." The Orzhov church runs as a bank, and the bank takes all three currencies.

cards.name: Mortify
cards.why_it_fits: A stern blonde woman in a dark formal coat, hands raised, a ring of cracked light radiating from her chest. Her expression is neutral. The flavor text reads "Your debt is erased" and is attributed to Hilgur, an Orzhov euthanist. The word euthanist tells you what the erasure costs.

cards.name: Tithe Drinker
cards.why_it_fits: Orzhov vampire seated at a banquet table, raising a chalice in formal black-and-gold robes. The card is named for the figure's job: collecting blood and coin on the Orzhov's behalf. MTG lore frames the Orzhov as the Church of Deals, part church and part bank.

cards.name: Lawmage's Binding
cards.why_it_fits: Two Azorius lawmages in white-and-blue robes, hoods up, casting chains of magic around a horned figure who's leaning away. The captive's body is mid-resistance. The first instant-speed Pacifism in MTG history per the set's design retrospective, written to outpace the defendant.

cards.name: Lunarch Mantle
cards.why_it_fits: A figure under huge angel wings, faceless in white plate, sword raised straight up. The card is an Aura the knight wears. The flavor text speaker is Manfried Ulmach, Chief Inquisitor of the Lunarch Inquisition, a named Innistrad church-and-army figure. The wings are church-issued.

cards.name: Reverent Hoplite
cards.why_it_fits: A column of hoplites in step past a hillside shrine, spears up, banner up, all the helmets the same. Wizards built this as Theros Beyond Death's echo of Evangel of Heliod from the 2013 block: same soldier-procession motif, same set, ten years later.

cards.name: Secure the Scene
cards.why_it_fits: Two armored figures approaching, blue spell-glow at the front of the frame. The flavor text speaker is Judith the Scourge Diva, a Rakdos character calling out an Azorius arrest. The bundle holds two copies; they look better together than apart.

pricing.diy_alternative_note: Ten cards across seven sets means ~3-4 TCGplayer sellers minimum at plain-envelope rates. Realistic floor; could be higher.
pricing.shipping_policy: buyer-paid, itemized separately at checkout; never included in list price
pricing.premium_justification: The $2.39 above cost basis pays for the framing. Ten cards of common bulk are $1.61 of paper. The bundle's value is reading the cards in sequence with the title doing the lifting.

metadata.notes: v4 recast. Theme tightened from 'Sleep when you're dead' (interior labor experience) to 'Tithe' (the apparatus of extraction, the men they send). Anchors: Wicked Guardian, Charity Extractor, Pitiless Pontiff. Dropped Mind Rot (interior body-horror) and Deafening Silence (victims rather than face of institution). Added Mortify, Tithe Drinker, Lunarch Mantle, Reverent Hoplite, Secure the Scene (2x). Secure the Scene at 2x leverages the only multi-copy candidate in the match set.
